nom: Mad Hippie AHA + BHA Milk Serum

avis.texte: I have combo skin that changes with the seasons. I'm oilier in the summer and drier in the winter, so I like to keep my routine gentle and balanced without using too many actives. My goal is graceful aging, and I feel like overdoing strong ingredients can backfire. I use this once a week and have had no irritation, which makes me even more interested in it. It makes my skin feel really soft, gives me immediate hydration, and even seems to help with blackheads. Milky serums and cleansers are already my favorite, so this really appeals to me. The non-toxic, natural angle makes it even better. Give it a try!

I just started using the brand in the middle of February. So far, I am please with the results. This is lightweight and a little goes a long ways. It dries completely rather quickly, enabling you to apply hydrating lotion. My face can tends to be more on the sensitive side, I have had no issues. I have been given compliments on how great my skin looks! I can't wait to see how my face looks after the next two months!
I've been using the serum for about a week so it's too early to tell if it is helping clear my acne. I hope it does!

avis.titre: I AM REALLY LOVING THIS SERUM!!!
avis.texte: I love how this serum feels on my 72-year-old drier skin. I follow it up with the Mad Hippie Eye Cream and Triple C Night Cream. I alternate nights with the Super A Serum. My skin looks amazing with Mad Hippie and I absolutely love how clean this skin care line is. I got rid of all my toxic skin care a few years ago and have been enjoying Mad Hippie ever since. I love that it's for all ages, young and mature skin alike.

This serum is simply incredible! It provides triple benefit chemical exfoliation without the harsh effects of other products. That's because it also has ceramides and squalane that deeply nourish skin and keep it plump and hydrated. The milky texture on this is amazing! It glides over skin perfectly and leaves the most beautiful glow. Soft, fresh and smooth skin days from even the first use. It's gentle enough for daily use. I can't say enough great things about this serum! Plus the price is extremely affordable for the benefits it provides. It's basically a one and done product for maintaining fresh and healthy skin!

I got the small bottle as a sample with my sunblock purchase. I had been using Tretinoin and Vivier Vit C serum. Added this in the mix and am alternating nights. There is a significant difference since I added the AHA/BHA serum to the routine. My skin looks and feels brand new.

This product is amazing! You put it on and like 10 seconds later your skin is baby soft. I have acne-prone skin and this does a good job of acting as a moisturizer and keeping my skin clear. I don't need to follow it with anything after, its a one stop shop

This serum is the best thing that has ever happened to my skin! My maturing skin was still prone to breakouts. This product solves both problems. Combined with the antioxidant face oil, it is perfection.

I received a very generous 0.5 oz sample droper bottle of this with my purchase. The results were instant for me, the smoothing and texture of my skin and hydration was incredible. Its very milky in texture and its technically fragrance free, but I detect a slight sweetness, I suspect is from the beets, but I love it.

The balance of treatment with repair here is excellent. My skin is responding beautifully to this with tighter pores and brighter finish. Having both acids in one is fantastically convenient. The texture is smooth and calming, not sticky and amazingly not drying. Mad Hippie gets it right, again!
Love it so far. Tingling sensation at first that's very subtle. Looking forward to results. I use tretinoin normally but paused for now to see what this beauty can do.
